<translated_code>
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 20;
    static final int MAX_NOD = 400;
    static final int MAX_EDG = 200000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;

    static int[][] grid = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] spfa_dist = new int[MAX_NOD];
    static int[] spfa_queue = new int[MAX_NOD];
    static int[] in_spfa = new int[MAX_NOD];
    static int[][] all_dist = new int[MAX_NOD][MAX_NOD];
    static int n_nodes, N, TIME_LIMIT;
    static String current_line;
    static int zr, zc;
    static int[] dr = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dc = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static class FlowEdge {
        int src, dst, cap, next;
        FlowEdge(int s, int d, int c, int n) {
            src = s; dst = d; cap = c; next = n;
        }
    }

    static FlowEdge[] edges = new FlowEdge[MAX_EDG];
    static int[] edge_head = new int[MAX_NOD];
    static int edge_count;
    static int source_node, sink_node;
    static List<Integer> sources = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> destinations = new ArrayList<>();

    static int to_id(int r, int c) {
        return (r - 1) * N + c;
    }

    static boolean is_valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 1 && r <= N && c >= 1 && c <= N && grid[r][c] != -1;
    }

    static void construct_adjacency() {
        n_nodes = N * N;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n_nodes; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n_nodes; ++j) {
                all_dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                if (grid[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int u = to_id(r, c);
                all_dist[u][u] = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
                    if (is_valid(nr, nc)) {
                        int v = to_id(nr, nc);
                        all_dist[u][v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa_compute() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n_nodes; ++i) spfa_dist[i] = INF;
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        int start = to_id(zr, zc);
        spfa_dist[start] = 0;
        spfa_queue[tail++] = start;
        while (head < tail) {
            int u = spfa_queue[head++];
            for (int v = 1; v <= n_nodes; ++v) {
                if (all_dist[u][v] == 1 && spfa_dist[v] > spfa_dist[u] + 1) {
                    spfa_dist[v] = spfa_dist[u] + 1;
                    spfa_queue[tail++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void floyd_warshall() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= n_nodes; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n_nodes; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n_nodes; ++j) {
                    if (all_dist[i][k] != -1 && all_dist[k][j] != -1) {
                        if (all_dist[i][j] == -1 || all_dist[i][j] > all_dist[i][k] + all_dist[k][j]) {
                            all_dist[i][j] = all_dist[i][k] + all_dist[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void initialize_flow_network() {
        Arrays.fill(edge_head, -1);
        edge_count = 0;
        source_node = 0;
        sink_node = sources.size() / 3 + destinations.size() / 3 + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < sources.size(); i += 3) {
            int cnt = sources.get(i + 2);
            edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(source_node, i / 3 + 1, cnt, edge_head[source_node]);
            edge_head[source_node] = edge_count++;
            edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(i / 3 + 1, source_node, 0, edge_head[i / 3 + 1]);
            edge_head[i / 3 + 1] = edge_count++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < destinations.size(); i += 3) {
            int cnt = destinations.get(i + 2);
            int node_id = sources.size() / 3 + i / 3 + 1;
            edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(node_id, sink_node, cnt, edge_head[node_id]);
            edge_head[node_id] = edge_count++;
            edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(sink_node, node_id, 0, edge_head[sink_node]);
            edge_head[sink_node] = edge_count++;
        }

        int src_pos = to_id(zr, zc);
        for (int i = 0; i < sources.size(); i += 3) {
            int sr = sources.get(i), sc = sources.get(i + 1);
            int sp = to_id(sr, sc);
            for (int j = 0; j < destinations.size(); j += 3) {
                int dr_dest = destinations.get(j), dc_dest = destinations.get(j + 1);
                int dp = to_id(dr_dest, dc_dest);
                if (all_dist[sp][dp] != -1 && all_dist[sp][dp] <= TIME_LIMIT) {
                    if (all_dist[sp][dp] < spfa_dist[dp]) {
                        int src_id = i / 3 + 1;
                        int dst_id = sources.size() / 3 + j / 3 + 1;
                        edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(src_id, dst_id, INF, edge_head[src_id]);
                        edge_head[src_id] = edge_count++;
                        edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(dst_id, src_id, 0, edge_head[dst_id]);
                        edge_head[dst_id] = edge_count++;
                    } else if (all_dist[sp][dp] == spfa_dist[dp]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nr = dr_dest + dr[d], nc = dc_dest + dc[d];
                            if (is_valid(nr, nc)) {
                                int np = to_id(nr, nc);
                                if (all_dist[sp][np] == all_dist[sp][dp] - 1 && all_dist[sp][np] < spfa_dist[np]) {
                                    int src_id = i / 3 + 1;
                                    int dst_id = sources.size() / 3 + j / 3 + 1;
                                    edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(src_id, dst_id, INF, edge_head[src_id]);
                                    edge_head[src_id] = edge_count++;
                                    edges[edge_count] = new FlowEdge(dst_id, src_id, 0, edge_head[dst_id]);
                                    edge_head[dst_id] = edge_count++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NOD];
    static int[] q_bfs = new int[MAX_NOD];

    static boolean bfs_flow() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        int f = 0, r = 0;
        q_bfs[r++] = source_node;
        level[source_node] = 0;
        while (f < r) {
            int u = q_bfs[f++];
            for (int e = edge_head[u]; e != -1; e = edges[e].next) {
                int v = edges[e].dst;
                if (level[v] == -1 && edges[e].cap > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    if (v == sink_node) return true;
                    q_bfs[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == sink_node) return flow;
        for (int e = edge_head[u]; e != -1; e = edges[e].next) {
            int v = edges[e].dst;
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && edges[e].cap > 0) {
                int f = dfs_flow(v, Math.min(flow, edges[e].cap));
                if (f > 0) {
                    edges[e].cap -= f;
                    edges[e ^ 1].cap += f;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic_maxflow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs_flow()) {
            int[] temp_head = new int[edge_head.length];
            System.arraycopy(edge_head, 0, temp_head, 0, edge_head.length);
            for (int i = 0; i <= sink_node; ++i) edge_head[i] = temp_head[i];
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs_flow(source_node, INF)) > 0) flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int solve_system() {
        grid[zr][zc] = 0;
        construct_adjacency();
        spfa_compute();
        grid[zr][zc] = -1;
        construct_adjacency();
        floyd_warshall();
        initialize_flow_network();
        return dinic_maxflow();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        TIME_LIMIT = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        sources.clear();
        destinations.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(grid[i], 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            current_line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = current_line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    zr = i; zc = j+1;
                    grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                }
                else if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    sources.add(i);
                    sources.add(j+1);
                    sources.add(ch - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            current_line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = current_line.charAt(j);
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    destinations.add(i);
                    destinations.add(j+1);
                    destinations.add(ch - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve_system());
    }
}
